note: White River NF (Dillon Ranger District) campground in the Peninsula Recreation Area on Dillon Reservoir near Frisco, off Hwy 9: paved parking-lot-style sites in two rows along a central lane, the west row facing the open shore. Motorboats must launch from the Dillon Marina after an aquatic nuisance species inspection; swimming and other water contact are prohibited. Dillon Reservoir ran low in 2026 (Denver Water: down 20 ft by late July, a near-record low projected for April 2027), which widens the beach in front of the sites. --Claude
